entities.name: Goran Knežević
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Goran Knežević is a Serbian politician and former professional basketball player. His father is Vuksan Knežević, former Yugoslav political dissident and writer who was sent to prison camp Goli Otok at the age of 17. He served as the Minister of Economy of Serbia from 2016 to 2020.
